subject.title: fix(meeting-bot): avoid stale state during transcript and browser recovery

question: Should browser-managed Google Meet talkback permanently require an explicit `micMuted: false` observation, replacing the prior behavior that allowed an unknown microphone state?
rationale: This is a deliberate upgrade-visible readiness-policy change, not a mechanical bug repair: a previously usable browser-managed talkback session can now wait for DOM verification before speech starts.

options.title: Confirm explicit-unmuted fail-closed policy
options.body: Keep the new safety policy and require real signed-in or paired-node proof for the unknown, muted, and post-unmute states before merge.

options.title: Preserve prior unknown-state readiness
options.body: Restore the former behavior for unknown microphone state and retain only the transcript and recovery fixes if compatibility is more important than fail-closed talkback.

recommendation.title: Confirm explicit-unmuted fail-closed policy
recommendation.body: Keep the new safety policy and require real signed-in or paired-node proof for the unknown, muted, and post-unmute states before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current feature-history trail identifies steipete as the author of the merged meeting-bot extraction and this follow-up policy change.
